shopping trolley noun

also trolley, cart

* our formation

* (our own formation) carrulus, carrulī m.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

Our use (L&S: a small cart).

Examples

  • carrulum trūdere

    push the trolleycomposed

  • Carrulum Theodōrus trūdere voluit; sed cum carrulus ipsō major esset, in eō sēdit, patre impellente.

    Theo wanted to push the trolley; but as it was bigger than he was, he sat in it while Dad pushed.Libellus IV, Diēs Grātulātiōnis

See also supermarket.

SourcesLewis & Short: carrulus · Lewis & Short: trudo
